title: The cheapest worst chair ever!
text: The cheapest worst chair ever!. This was so hard to put together and get the seat part on that it took me many tries and I broke a nail putting it together, this things terrible! Then when you finally get it together you realize it's the most narrow, wobbly, and snug fitting chair ever. Absolutely would not pay $1 for this garbage. I'd ask for a refund had I bought it.

product_metadata.title: ABCCANOPY Ultralight Portable Camping Chairs Lightweight Compact Folding Chair, Capacity for Outdoor Camp,Travel, Beach, Picnic, Hiking, Dark Gray
features: Durability: This lightweight chair is made of high-strength 7075 aircraft grade aluminum alloy frame with 210D Riplock Fabric. Weighs only 2 pounds but can hold up to 264.6 pounds/120kg.

Portability: Foldable mesh and metal poles make it easy to set up and fold down, put into your carry bag. The carry bag size is only 14*5.1*3.9inch, very easy and convenient for storage and transportation.
Comfortable: Unique and ergonomic seat design gives you the best seat experience allowing you to relax. Breathable and soft seat net makes you feel comfortable.
Versatility: Perfect choice for Backpackers, Tailgaters, Hikers, Concertgoers, Campers, Adventurers, and anyone looking for comfort without the bulk.
Warranty: We provide one year quality guarantee, any issues about this chair, please contact us at once, we will provide a satisfied solution for you.
